name: Gasthaus Zur schönen Aussicht
beschreibung:
Elevated in a sunny vantage point in Rettenschoess, Gasthaus Zur schoenen Aussicht lives up to its name with commanding vistas of the Kaiser range, hearty meals, and welcoming guestrooms.

Alpine pasture trails, scenic walking routes, and Lake Walchsee are just a short journey away.
kurzbeschreibung: Gasthaus Zur schoenen Aussicht in Rettenschoess provides sweeping panoramas over the Kaiser mountains.
